studio_readings_unverified_d5: drag-line geometry: linear v.d/L^2, reflected |v.d|/L^2, radial |v|/L, diamond (|v.u|+|v.n|)/L, angle counter-clockwise on screen from the drag, one turn = 1
midpoint curve piecewise linear (f = m gives 0.5); a stop's midpoint governs the segment to the next stop
dither +-0.5/255 per channel from blend_math::site_unit (seeded, deterministic), colour only
bucket tolerance metric and anti-alias kernel = the magic wand's (Chebyshev on premultiplied RGBA in 8-bit display levels; 3x3 box on the boundary)

viewer works on sRGB-encoded values (interpolation, tolerance, blend) and decodes the replacement to the linear tiles; foreground = brush colour; default gradient foreground to transparent; pattern tiled from the document origin at 100 %

Kept, exact mismatch: (1) the masked_replace request in fill_tools::replace_block: brush_mix::replace_block(target, tile, block, colour, alpha, rgb: [f32; 3], mask) builds its replacement inside from ONE colour (paint_replacement(block, rgb, ..)) and has no parameter for per-pixel replacement planes; reuse needs a behaviour change there (a planes-taking core that replace_block wraps). (2) the sRGB decode: Prism exposes only the encode (DisplayEncoding::encode); the viewer's own edit::linear takes u8 and would quantize the replacement to 8 bits
